description: Fragment of genealogical list of Geonim of Palestine. In the hand of Sahlān b. Avraham. Ca. 1040. On verso there appear the signatures of Zarʿa b. ʿAmram, Avraham b. Shabbetay (or Shabbat), and Yosef b. [...], presumably related to an earlier document. (Information in part from Gil and from Zachary Rothblatt via FGP.)
description_he: שבר רשימת יוחסין של גאונים. כ-1040.
